svg.aria-label: Crow: an agent, not a chat box. Features, tools, images, operating points.
svg.text: An agent, not a chat box.▍
A local model at 200k context with 31 tools
and MCP, persistent memory, its own skills, a
browser panel, eyes, and subagents it can send
out while it keeps working. It makes and edits
images beside crow-nest's 27B, on one 32 GB
card. Runs on this machine, or on a provider
crow-nest CNQ4.5-M, RTX 5090. Decode: Linux 2026-09-24, after
the PLE fix. Prefill: Windows 2026-09-13/14. Source:
two plain-text stores, per project and per person
procedures the model keeps and rewrites
a plan in the pinned head, it survives a restart
delegate, subtasks, collect: up to 16 at once
tabs and an address bar, render_page for the model
read_image, a drop, a paste; Flash-Next and the 27B
folder, download, size in MB; on the phone too
SQLite FTS5 over every archived conversation
stdio and Streamable HTTP, OAuth, per-tool classes
OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI. Default: this machine
the window on a paired phone, LAN or Tailscale
dictation via faster-whisper, nothing written to disk
a file with an ACL, not an inherited env variable
git_push asks at every level. A path outside the
31 built in, plus every MCP tool
In the chat an animated square in the theme's
colours stands where the picture will be, then
the clip: median of 5, 2026-10-02. Source: docs/
* at 122k context. † before the PLE fix, not re-measured. —
not measured. Dates and sources: docs/operating-points.md
Copy it right below this picture.
One line, Windows or Linux. Preflight, download, a
per-file sha256 against the release manifest. No
root, no elevation. One window, Windows or Linux:
CrowSetup from the release installs Crow, the
crow-nest engine and the operating points you
